description: This file defines the 'EndpointOptions' class in the Orleans.Configuration namespace. It manages configuration options for silo endpoints in an Orleans cluster, including IP addresses and ports for communication between silos and clients, with validation logic and helper methods for setting up network endpoints.

classes.name: EndpointOptions
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring the network endpoints of an Orleans silo, including IP address and port settings, with validation and helper methods for obtaining endpoint representations.

methods.name: AdvertisedIPAddress
methods.description: Gets or sets the IP address used for clustering. Includes validation to prevent invalid IPs.

methods.name: SiloPort
methods.description: Gets or sets the port used for silo-to-silo communication, with validation to prevent zero value.

methods.name: GetPublicSiloEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the IPEndPoint representing the public silo endpoint (IP + SiloPort).

methods.name: GetPublicProxyEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the IPEndPoint for the proxy endpoint, considering GatewayPort and GatewayListeningEndpoint.

methods.name: GetListeningSiloEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the IPEndPoint for listening to silo communication, defaulting to public endpoint if specific is not set.

methods.name: GetListeningProxyEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the IPEndPoint for listening to gateway communication, defaulting to public proxy endpoint if specific is not set.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Configures the endpoints based on the provided IConfiguration object, parsing and setting IP address and port values.
